rachel-docs: FYI I opened a small docs PR to harmonize SOC2 wording on audit exports and retention + add three tiny SDK snippets (py/ts/curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6120

 tom-security: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) avoid 'we keep' or 'indefinitely' phrasing; 2) add a short sentence that exported datasets are access-controlled and logged.

 anya-eng: I added minimal examples — python, ts (async), and a curl one-liner. Python: ```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.query_events(sample=0.01, start="2025-03-01", end="2025-03-31")
print(resp.get("total"))
```

 rachel-docs: Can legal confirm preferred phrasing for retention? Current draft: 'Logs retained 90 days by default; exports for compliance may be retained longer.'

 sam-legal: Use: 'Customer audit logs are retained for 90 days by default. As required by law or contractual obligations, retention for specific exports may be extended; contact legal@redwood.com for legal-hold requests. Example identifiers in this guide are pseudonymized.'

 tom-security: Add a short callout about sampling bias — samples are fine for ops triage but may miss rare anomalies; recommend full exports for investigations. Also please show a one-line pseudonymized example (user_id: sha256:...).

 anya-eng: Pseudonymized example added: { "user_id": "sha256:ab12cd...", "event": "model.query", "ts": "2025-03-15T12:00:00Z" }

 merge-bot: PR updated and reviewers requested: @tom-security @sam-legal @anya-eng

 rachel-docs: Thanks all. Will merge after security + legal OK and CI linkcheck passes.
